import json
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

REPO = Path("/work/fastapi")

def head_sha():
    try:
        out = subprocess.run(["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"], cwd=REPO, capture_output=True, text=True, check=True)
        return out.stdout.strip()
    except Exception:
        return "unknown"

def ep(name, kind, location, signature=None, plain=None):
    d = {"name": name, "kind": kind, "location": location}
    if signature:
        d["signature"] = signature
    if plain:
        d["plain"] = plain
    return d

def dep(unit, entrypoint):
    return {"unit": unit, "entrypoint": entrypoint}

def eff(kind, description):
    return {"kind": kind, "description": description}

# ---- excluded: every non-fastapi/ source file (tests, docs examples, dev/release tooling) ----
SRC_EXT = {".py", ".js", ".ts", ".tsx", ".go", ".rs", ".java", ".c", ".cc", ".cpp", ".h", ".hpp"}
SKIP_DIRS = {".git", "node_modules", "vendor", "target", "build", "dist", "__pycache__", ".claude", "examples"}

def excluded_reason(rel: str) -> str:
    if rel.startswith("tests/"):
        return "Test suite: exercises the fastapi/ units' behavior but is not itself part of the shipped library."
    if rel.startswith("docs_src/"):
        return "Documentation example snippet embedded in the docs site; illustrative usage code, not part of the fastapi package."
    if rel.startswith("scripts/"):
        return "Repository maintenance/release/docs-tooling script; not part of the shipped fastapi package."
    return "Out of scope: not part of the fastapi/ package."

excluded = []
for top in ("tests", "docs_src", "scripts"):
    d = REPO / top
    if not d.exists():
        continue
    for p in sorted(d.rglob("*")):
        if p.is_file() and p.suffix in SRC_EXT and not (set(p.parts) & SKIP_DIRS):
            rel = str(p.relative_to(REPO))
            excluded.append({"path": rel, "reason": excluded_reason(rel)})

# ---- unpartitioned: in-scope source files neither owned nor excluded ----
all_src = set()
for p in REPO.rglob("*"):
    if p.is_file() and p.suffix in SRC_EXT and not (set(p.parts) & SKIP_DIRS):
        all_src.add(str(p.relative_to(REPO)))

owned = set(all_declared)
excluded_paths = {e["path"] for e in excluded}
unpartitioned_paths = sorted(all_src - owned - excluded_paths)
unpartitioned = [{"path": p, "reason": "In scope but not yet triaged by this pass."} for p in unpartitioned_paths]

manifest = {
    "repo": f"tiangolo/fastapi@{head_sha()}",
    "units": units,
    "excluded": excluded,
    "unpartitioned": unpartitioned,
    "violations_observed": violations_observed,
}

Path("/out").mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
with open("/out/manifest.json", "w") as f:
    json.dump(manifest, f, indent=2)
    f.write("\n")

print("units:", len(units))
print("excluded:", len(excluded))
print("unpartitioned:", len(unpartitioned))
print("all_src total:", len(all_src))
print("owned:", len(owned))
